incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A street is flooded with brown water, submerging the lower levels of several multi-story buildings.

observations.description: Brown, murky water covers the street and reaches up to the ground level of buildings.
Multi-story buildings with storefronts and arched doorways line the flooded street.
Small patches of greenery are visible on the building facades, possibly climbing plants or ivy.
A stop sign and a blue arrow directional sign are visible on the right side of the image.
